claim_boundary: This boundary records ROADMAP dispositions for all 55 PDF-verified named AlphaEvolve structural spans, including sections, figures, tables, appendices, source pages, local status, roadmap section, phase bucket, sidecars, and active audit TODO links, plus 846 bounded claim-level records: 56 Table 1/Section 2 system requirements and 45 Abstract, Introduction, Discussion, and collaborator-context claims, plus 44 Section 3.1, Table 2, Figure 4, and footnote 3 matrix-result claims, plus 63 Section 3.2 and Figure 5 constructive-math claims, plus 45 Section 3.3 opening, Section 3.3.1, and Figure 6 scheduling claims, plus 59 Section 3.3.2 and Figure 7 kernel-engineering claims, plus 35 Section 3.3.3 hardware-circuit-design claims, plus 44 Section 3.3.4 compiler-generated-code claims, plus 51 Section 4 and Figure 8 ablation claims, plus 85 Section 5 Related Work claims separated into 59 source-context-only and 26 implementation-relevant claims, plus 131 Appendix A, Table 3, and Figure 9 claims, plus 188 Appendix B and Figures 10-14 claims across all 13 subsections, plus lexical source and bibliography linkage for all 195 TeX citation uses, 240 key links, and 120 compiled references, plus construct-level disposition for all 30 retained-source captions, five equation-environment constructs, and semantic footnotes, plus row- and cell-level dispositions for all 83 rows and 240 cells in Tables 1-3, plus environment- and line-level dispositions for all 8 retained TeX code listing environments and all 305 physical source lines, plus delimiter-level dispositions for all 309 explicit TeX math constructs, split into 291 inline and 18 display constructs, plus paragraph- and sentence-level dispositions for all 128 retained TeX prose paragraphs and all 402 grammatical sentences: 372 mapped to existing bounded claims, 30 reviewed as nonclaims, and zero unmapped or unresolved, plus 244 atomic propositions across all 98 Abstract, Introduction, and Methods sentences: 226 mapped to bounded claims and 18 dispositioned as context, outlook, or interpretation. It does not cover propositions in the remaining 304 prose sentences or provide independent semantic review. It does not classify citation semantics, source sufficiency, or implementation relevance, and does not claim whole-paper proposition-level semantic exhaustiveness, mathematical correctness, image-pixel coverage, citation-semantic exhaustiveness, independent semantic review, or result reproduction, a claim-level application-result matrix, complete paper-index row to ROADMAP disposition map, proof that every missing or partial source span has a live TODO, or a CI source-span exhaustiveness gate.
